title: MIST: Jailbreaking Black-box Large Language Models via Iterative Semantic Tuning
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical security attack method (jailbreaking) for Large Language Models. While it discusses the models' alignment with 'moral values' as the mechanism it seeks to bypass, the core research and evaluation are centered on the efficacy of the jailbreak method rather than benchmarking or exploring moral reasoning, ethical frameworks, or religious topics.
